Why Astra

Everything you need,
nothing you don't

Eight reasons people switch to Astra and stay.

Native Audio Engine
Built on a native Kotlin/Media3 engine instead of a plugin wrapper, so playback stays smooth and battery-friendly.
Instant Smart Search
Direct-call search resolves results fast and filters out near-duplicate tracks automatically.
Synced Lyrics
Lyrics scroll in real time with the song, with retry logic that handles typos and trimmed versions.
Built for TV, Too
AstraTV brings the same library and playback to your Android TV, built from scratch alongside the phone app.
No Play Store Gatekeeping
Distributed straight from GitHub Releases, so updates ship the moment they're ready, no review queue.
Battery-Aware Casting
Cast discovery only runs when you actually cast, not silently in the background draining your battery.
Speaks Your Language
Localized across 16 languages, so the interface reads naturally wherever you're listening from.
Kept Lightweight, On Purpose
Every release goes through a real audit pass to strip dead code, so the app stays fast even on older phones.
